Properties.Name: TitleScr
Properties.Description:
Makes the title screen animation continuous instead of freezing after
 pressing START Button/ENTER Key.

Properties.Name: DemoMode
Properties.Description:
Enables Demo Mode that is leftover in the Windows port of the game.
GameCube and PlayStation ports contain Demo Gameplay by default.

Properties.Name: Exit
Properties.Description: Remove prompt when trying to exit the game.

Properties.Name: TDarkChaosEmeEnum
Properties.Description:
Chaos Emerald from Chaos Inferno has different blendings
 compared to other ports. Not to mention its model and
 blendings are completely different from SA2.

'Console Style' brings the same blendings as GC/XB/PS.
'SA2 Style' brings a similar approach to SA2's emeralds.

Note: Now the emerald's model by default is changed to
 use SA2's model as well.

Properties.Name: ADV_PL_Cheese
Properties.Description: Display Cheese in Team Selection Menus.

Properties.Name: IndirectOFF
Properties.Description:
Use texture pattern animation (TXC, also similar to PS2 port)
instead of indirect shaders.
